boundaries: Readiness level sizes are graph observations, not actual concurrency, admission permission or a general graph-width theorem.
No thread spawn in the inspected synchronous compute/map/collect branch is not a claim of absent internal tool parallelism.
Actual sibling orders differ despite deterministic pinned DAG source; raw receipts and unknown service revision are retained.
Reported0ms is not zero cost; empty cache hits/null keys do not supply a cache-hit experiment.
Expected7/4 attempts and7/8success are assumption-bound; fluid15attempt-work excess is not15observed queued jobs.
Authored delayed-completion traces do not execute retries/cancellation; refusing a new start does not stop an active attempt.
Intended state/effect idempotence is distinct from equal return values; ideal serial atomic dedup is not delivered durable/crash/concurrent correctness.
